name: sample-theme
title: Sample Storefront
description: An example Blokkli theme: a Nuxt storefront that renders a tenant's products and CMS pages. Demonstrates the kind/engine marker, domain-based frontend routing, the `requires` install gate, and the shared permissions register (ADR-0061).

requires.reason: renders the product grid on the storefront home and category pages

blocks.description: A WYSIWYG text block for editorial content.
